description: Model-implied E[P_T] produced by the LEGACY asinh-OU model (legacy_asinh_ou) before the forward-centered rebuild. Recorded verbatim from the reported diagnostic run so the explosion can be reproduced and plotted without the full historical artefact bundle.
model: legacy_asinh_ou (M2 Gaussian TVTP, P = scale_P * sinh(y))
provenance: reported legacy diagnostic output; used only as a benchmark curve, never as a pricing input
